Interviewer: Walk me through how you exercise during the week.
P3: I regularly go to the gym four times a week. I never skip leg day.
Interviewer: What about this past month?
P3: I actually went twice in the last three weeks. My schedule got really disrupted.
Interviewer: How do you handle sleep?
P3: I always try to be in bed by ten. I make it a priority because it affects my whole day.
Interviewer: And in practice?
P3: I was up until one last night. I found myself scrolling for two hours.
